fullPassage: According to Henry Petroski, real knowledge from real failure is the most powerful source of progress we have, provided we have the courage to carefully examine what happened. Perhaps this is why the Boeing Company, one of the largest airplane design and engineering firms in the world, keeps a black book of lessons it has learned from design and engineering failures! Boeing has kept this document since the company was formed, and it uses it to help modern designers learn from past attempts. Any organization that manages to do this not only increases its chances for successful projects, but also helps create an environment that can discuss and confront failure openly, instead of denying and hiding from it. It seems that software developers need to keep black books of their own.

det.analysis: 본문 'the Boeing Company ... keeps a black book of lessons it has learned from ... failures'에서 보잉이 교훈을 기록해 보관하는 것은 black book(블랙북)입니다.
det.tip: keeps a ___ of lessons 부분에서 2단어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: According to Henry Petroski, real knowledge from real failure is the most powerful source of progress we have, provided we have the courage to carefully examine what happened. Perhaps this is why the Boeing Company, one of the largest airplane design and engineering firms in the world, keeps a black book of lessons it has learned from design and engineering failures! Boeing has kept this document since the company was formed, and it uses it to help modern designers learn from past attempts. Any organization that manages to do this not only increases its chances for successful projects, but also helps create an environment that can discuss and confront failure openly, instead of denying and hiding from it. It seems that software developers need to keep black books of their own.
questions.stem: 위 글에서, 현대 설계자들이 보잉의 기록을 통해 배우게 된다고 한 '과거의 ~'에 해당하는 2단어 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 설계자들이 배우는 대상.
det.analysis: 본문 'to help modern designers learn from past attempts'에서 설계자들이 배우는 대상은 past attempts(과거의 시도)입니다.
det.tip: learn from ___ 부분에서 2단어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: According to Henry Petroski, real knowledge from real failure is the most powerful source of progress we have. The Boeing Company keeps a black book of lessons it has __________ (learn) from design and engineering failures.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

... a black book of lessons it has __________ (learn) from design and engineering failures.

det.korean: learn을 현재완료 형태로 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'it has ___ from ... failures'에서 'has + 과거분사'의 현재완료가 필요해요. learn을 과거분사 learned로 바꿔 'has learned(배워 온)'를 완성해요.
det.tip: 현재완료 has + 과거분사: has learned.

questions.passage: According to Henry Petroski, real knowledge from real failure is the most powerful source of progress we have, provided we have the courage to carefully examine what happened. Perhaps this is why the Boeing Company, one of the largest airplane design and engineering firms in the world, keeps a black book of lessons it has learned from design and engineering failures! Boeing has kept this document since the company was formed, and it uses it to help modern designers learn from past attempts. Any organization that manages to do this not only increases its chances for successful projects, but also helps create an environment that can discuss and confront failure openly, instead of denying and hiding from it. It seems that software developers need to keep black books of their own.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 관통하는 주제를 고르는 문항이에요.
det.analysis:
① 설계 기술의 역사가 아니에요.
② 문서 보관 시스템 구축법이 아니에요.
③ 글 전체가 실패를 용기 있게 살펴보고 기록해 진보의 원천으로 삼는 태도(보잉의 black book 사례)를 다루므로 주제로 적절해요. ← 정답
④ 개발 언어의 변천사가 아니에요.
det.tip: 실패를 진보로 바꾸는 '기록·직면' 태도가 주제예요.

ch: 대기업의 문서 보관 시스템 구축 방법
실패를 기록하고 공개적으로 마주해 진보의 원천으로 삼는 태도

questions.passage: According to Henry Petroski, real knowledge from real failure is the most powerful source of progress we have, provided we have the courage to carefully examine what happened. Perhaps this is why the Boeing Company, one of the largest airplane design and engineering firms in the world, keeps a black book of lessons it has learned from design and engineering failures! Boeing has kept this document since the company was formed, and it uses it to help modern designers learn from past attempts. Any organization that manages to do this not only increases its chances for successful projects, but also helps create an environment that can discuss and confront failure openly, instead of denying and hiding from it. It seems that software developers need to keep black books of their own.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심.
det.analysis:
① 본문은 실패를 '공개적으로 직면하라'고 하므로 '숨겨 잊어라'는 반대예요.
② 본문은 실패에서 배운다고 하므로 '실수를 하지 않는다'는 반대예요.
③ 본문은 과거의 실패에서 배우라고 하므로 '과거를 잊어라'는 반대예요.
④ 실패를 용기 있게 살펴보고 기록하면 진보와 성공 가능성을 높인다는 글의 결론과 일치해요. ← 정답
det.tip: 실패 기록·직면 → 진보와 성공 가능성 증가가 요지예요.

ch: 성공한 기업은 결코 실수를 하지 않는다.
실패를 용기 있게 살펴보고 기록하면 조직의 진보와 성공 가능성을 높인다.

Boeing has kept this document since the company was formed, and it uses it to help modern designers learn from past attempts. Any organization that manages to do this not only increases its chances for successful projects, but also helps create an environment that can discuss and confront failure openly, instead of denying and hiding from it. It seems that __________.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'소프트웨어 개발자들은 자신만의 블랙북을 둘 필요가 있다.'

[조건]
(1) black, books, developers, keep, need, of, own, software, their, to 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 소프트웨어 개발자도 자신만의 블랙북을 둘 필요가 있다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- software developers(주어): 소프트웨어 개발자들은
- need to keep(동사+to부정사): 둘 필요가 있다
- black books of their own(목적어): 자신만의 블랙북을
- 'need to + 동사원형(~할 필요가 있다)' 구조이고 'of their own'은 '자신만의'를 뜻해요.
det.tip: need to + 동사원형. '자신만의'는 of their own.

questions.wa: software developers need to keep black books of their own
accept: software developers need to keep black books of their own
